game.core.rules.readable.title: Character Creation and Progression
game.core.rules.readable.summary: Character creation records selected origin, ability scores, class, and level-one choices; progression reads the active class definition before granting later features.

blocks.heading: Recorded progression
items: Create the level-one state from the character's confirmed selections and active definitions.
Read the active class progression for the character's new class level.
Record only the features, resources, and choices declared by that progression.

blocks.heading: Pending choices remain pending
blocks.body: If a required value has not been selected, the system reports the missing choice instead of fabricating a feature or default.

citations.locator: Character Creation > Step 3: Ability Scores > Generate Your Scores > Standard Array, PDF p. 21
